czar: n. a male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917) n. a person having great power
czarina: n. the wife or widow of a czar
czarist: a. of or relating to or characteristic of a czar
czech: n. a native of inhabitant of the Czech Republic n. the Slavic language of Czechs a. of or relating to Czechoslovakia or its people or their language
czechoslovak: n a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia
czechoslovakia: n. a former republic in central Europe; divided into Czech Republic and Slovakia in 1993
czechoslovakian: n. a native or inhabitant of the former republic of Czechoslovakia
